bugs.title: Filtered desktop queue displays local index while mobile preserves global queue position
bugs.repro: Same four-item fixture, select Midnight Tales. Video B is global position 2; desktop displays 1, mobile displays 2.
bugs.effect: Displayed queue rank differs across PC/mobile and desktop does not reflect actual global start order while filtered.

bugs.title: Mobile rules summary retains removed image/rescan setting reads instead of workers plus channel cadence
bugs.repro: Open mobile Queue and scroll to Quy tắc chạy. Current summary reads 2 luồng · 3 ảnh · đối thủ mỗi 1 giờ; canonical MQueue reads 2 luồng · nhịp theo từng kênh.
source: apps/viderse/docs/design/v1/artboards/MQueue.dc.html:1150 rulesSum: W + luồng · nhịp theo từng kênh
bugs.effect: Readonly summary still consumes legacy fields removed from editable V39 rules; workers is the only editable setting, so this is copy/source-cutover mismatch, not an extra writable control.

unproven: All 11 matrix rows use UI_FIXTURE for target states; no native persisted running/paused/limited/empty prerequisite claimed. Native read-only queue captures separately recorded.
No provider result, generated media, playback or physical mobile/Safari proof.

All external source links checked as safe synthetic hrefs without external navigation.
Shared shell/account/navigation controls outside the owned Queue surfaces not exercised.
policy: All non-GET intercepted. Only PATCH /api/queue locally fulfilled. No providers, native queue writes, media, downloads, installs or scans.
qualification: Queue source unchanged since supplied native build per integration context; source hashes and served bundle hashes recorded, not a full UI-revision or pixel-parity claim.
controllerCorrections: Channel baseline endpoint corrected to /api/owner-channels before successful row coverage.
Desktop Undo accessible name includes countdown; locator corrected to /^Hoàn tác/.
Channel cadence field is Video mỗi ngày, not a heading named Nhịp kênh mỗi ngày.
Sheet capture now waits for full viewport intersection before screenshot; pre-animation capture replaced.
